title: The coord.py client ends in a traceback and exit 1 on a huge --timeout, a bad URL port or a non-ASCII token
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G4 (ST-rk5ks4pf): send() passes REQUEST_SECONDS + timeout to HTTPConnection, so wait --timeout 1e12 raises OverflowError, --url with port 99999 raises ValueError in parts.port, and renew --token with a non-ASCII token raises TypeError in compare_digest on str; each prints a traceback and exits 1, the code that means a held key or a moved revision. Each exits 2 with a one-line reason and no traceback.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
k=os.path.join(D,'k');open(k,'w').write('k'*40);os.chmod(k,0o600)
r1,_,e1=c('--url','http://127.0.0.1:99999','--key-file',k,'list')
r2,_,e2=c('--url','http://127.0.0.1:1','--key-file',k,'wait','--since','0','--timeout','1e12')
r3,_,e3=c('renew','K','--token','é')
print(dict(bad_port=r1,huge_timeout=r2,non_ascii_token=r3));sys.exit(0 if r1==2 and r2==2 and 'Traceback' not in e1+e2+e3 else 1)
